Two shipped regressions were attribute reads that did not exist -- request.is_disconnected (Flask has no such attribute) and engine.companion_manager (it is engine.companions). Both are reportAttributeAccessIssue, and neither mypy's default mode nor the test suite caught them. Full pyright reports 73 pre-existing findings on this codebase, mostly Optional access, so everything else stays off until someone chooses to take that on.
